title: checkout_hooks.commit
description: commit of a STAPEL_ORDERS['CHECKOUT_HOOKS'] entry, called after the checkout transaction that placed the order commits, and retried by the hook sweep until it answers ok. token may be null: act on (attempt_key, hook name). Idempotent. The answer may carry keys beyond ok (token, errors, ...); orders reads ok only. ok: true is final: orders never re-sends that call — a companion that does not know the attempt key may answer ok: true (and log on its side) to stop the retries. A cancel that arrives before an unanswered commit wins: orders stops retrying the commit and sends release (reason cancelled).

actor_id.description: The acting account id, guest or not; always sent since 0.2.0 (user_id is null for a guest).
